_readme: Brand profile for Audiogram Maker. One file per brand. Every color, logo, label and link in the video comes from here. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. Paths are relative to this file.

logo._note: style: wordmark (logo alone), icon (a square icon next to the brand name) or text (the brand name set in the caption font). style_dark / style_light override style for one look. dark_mode / light_mode: original (logo colors), white or dark (a clean one color version). Only recolor a single color logo; multi color logos and icons keep original. SVG or transparent PNG. on_dark is used on the dark style, on_light on the light style. If only one is given it is used for both. mark is an optional single color wordmark used as a very faint background watermark (about 1 percent, hidden during the payoff); leave it empty for icons, stickers or multi color logos. If there is no logo at all, the brand name is set as text.

colors._optional: ring_dark (default #FFFFFF), ring_light (default primary), text_light, key_light, button (default accent), button_light
colors._note: accent: the bright highlight (current word underline, progress bar, button, glow). Pick a vivid one. primary: the deeper brand color used for text accents in the light style. background_dark: the mid tone of the dark background (it is darkened toward the edges automatically). background_light: the light style page color.

font._note: Leave file empty to use Inter (installed with the kit). To use a brand font, point file at a .ttf/.otf/.woff2 the user has the right to use.

footer._note: cta_line is the small label before the link. The button shows '<code_label> <promo_code>' when a promo code is set, otherwise button_text, otherwise nothing. footer_text replaces the hosts row when there are no hosts.

captions._note: size: small | medium | large (60, 68, 76 px) or a number. highlight: underline (current word white with an accent underline, the default), color (current word in the accent color) or both. phrase_words: min and max words per caption line. Captions are always sentence case, never all caps. spelling: brand and product names the transcript should always spell this way.

format._note: 16:9 1920x1080 is the default for X. Vertical is not built into this kit yet.

delivery._note: chat (send files in the conversation) or drive (upload to the user's connected Google Drive folder).
